observations.result: 7 focused Bases tests pass with 32 expectations, including embedded fenced definitions, exact content spans, valid native YAML documents, unsupported-expression issues and unclosed-fence handling.
5 Markdown preview tests pass with 22 expectations; base fences are represented as inert data-only blocks and are never executed.
Routine gate passes at the pushed commit: 107 tests with 608 expectations, state/contract/architecture/surface/accessibility/layout/typecheck checks, Knip and changed-file Fallow.
Full local gate passes at the pushed commit: compile, distribution, quality-program, 107 tests with 608 expectations, Knip and report-only Fallow health.
No issues in the 8-file embedded Bases/Markdown preview increment.
GitHub Actions completed successfully on macOS, Windows and Ubuntu for commit 28540eca552457c2bb85c9adbb1b03707f7b6c17.
GitHub Actions packaged successfully on macOS, Windows and Ubuntu; release-manifest and packaged Electron runtime notice audits passed.

implemented: Added a pure embedded-base extractor that identifies fenced base blocks, retains their exact source spans and returns structured documents or visible compatibility issues without writing Markdown.
Added an inert shared Markdown preview block for base fences and a renderer adapter that displays the definition as read-only source rather than evaluating it in the renderer.
Added focused fixture coverage for valid, unsupported and unclosed embedded definitions and documented the reusable desktop/Expo data boundary.
limitations: Embedded definitions are parsed and safely representable but are not yet exposed as a separate interactive Bases panel from a Markdown note.
Full Obsidian formula/filter semantics, all YAML dialect constructs, plugin-provided layouts, reference Obsidian reopen comparisons and cross-platform visible interaction remain pending.
